title: Mission 06: Groundbreaking
story: The department won the annex expansion. Before anyone moves in, YOU pour the foundation: the entire directory structure for the new wing, built to the architect's plan. And the failed prototype scaffolding comes down - but rmdir only demolishes what is truly empty, which is exactly why the safety board trusts it.

badge.name: Groundbreaking: Foundations Poured
badge.desc: Mastered mkdir and rmdir by building a structure to spec and demolishing only what was empty.

tasks.brief: Read BRIEFING6.txt in your department directory. First shovel in the ground: create the directory expansion/ in your department directory.

checks.fail: The expansion/ directory does not exist yet.

tasks.brief: The architect's plan calls for expansion/wing_$MISSION_PROJ/floor1/suite_a - all levels at once. Plain mkdir refuses to build parents that do not exist; one option changes that. Build the whole path in ONE command.

checks.fail: The full path expansion/wing_<project>/floor1/suite_a does not exist yet (mkdir has a make-parents option).

tasks.brief: floor1 needs three sibling suites: suite_a (built), suite_b and suite_c. Add the missing two - brace expansion or two arguments, your call.

The records vault must be born private: create expansion/vault with permissions exactly 700. mkdir can set the mode AS it creates (one option does it in a single step); grading verifies the final lock, so a create-then-chmod also passes - but learn the one-step move.

checks.fail: The vault exists but its permissions are not 700 (mkdir has a mode option that sets permissions at creation).

tasks.brief: The failed prototype scaffolding_empty/ in your department directory is hollow - nothing inside. Demolish it with rmdir, the tool that only removes EMPTY directories.

scaffolding_occupied/ still has material inside (blueprint.txt). The safety rule: it must NOT be demolished while occupied. Prove discipline: empty it first by moving blueprint.txt into expansion/, THEN take the empty scaffolding down with rmdir.

checks.fail: blueprint.txt did not arrive intact in expansion/ (move it before demolishing).
scaffolding_occupied/ still stands (once empty, rmdir takes it down).

tasks.brief: The abandoned corridor temp/deep/deeper/deepest is empty all the way down. rmdir can demolish the WHOLE empty chain in one command with its parents option (start from the deepest path).

checks.fail: The temp/deep/deeper/deepest chain still exists (rmdir -p from the deepest path removes each newly-emptied parent on the way up).
The architect's plan has exactly ONE wing. Extra wings were built off-plan.

tasks.brief: BONUS: the inspector wants proof of work. Create expansion/inspection_$MISSION_PROJ using mkdir's verbose option and save the command's own printed confirmation line into expansion/permit.txt (redirect it).

checks.fail: permit.txt must contain mkdir's verbose confirmation naming the new directory.
